description: This file defines the 'DeleteHookCommandHandler' class, which handles delete commands for hooks within the Apache Fineract project. It implements command processing logic, specifically for deleting hook entities, and leverages Spring annotations for service declaration and transaction management.

classes.name: DeleteHookCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles deletion commands for hooks, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, and uses the HookWritePlatformService to perform delete operations.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command for a hook, invoking the deleteHook method on the write platform service with the entity ID from the command.
